stockRecipeProposal.canopyShrubAndFruit: The closed icosahedral meshes are visual envelopes, not solid dry biomass. Use an explicitly reviewed finite per-owner foliage/fruit dry-stock budget, never envelope volume as timber. Values remain withheld.
stockRecipeProposal.fronds: One-sided authored surface area, once per actual source frond. Areal dry-stock loading/conversion remains unmeasured; no cloth or grass assignment.
stockRecipeProposal.localShares: Each physical damage patch must have reviewed finite shares that sum to the owner budget; no duplicate, refill, hidden or zero-default stock.
stockRecipeProposal.trunks: Actual authored closed-solid volume may be measured, but dry-stock density/conversion and parent profile need review; no automatic frame fuel.

supportLimits: Source botanical associations are not joints or earth anchors. Plants do not brace the greenhouse; source floor/bed contacts remain unproved. No new root/pot/collider geometry.
